newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen up but may stall at 1,045 stg.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen up but may stall at 1,045 stg.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa futures could extend Monday's run-up on Tuesday but the rise could be stalled at 1,045 stg basis September, technical analysts said.
Traders called the market to open 10 stg higher.
Cocoa moved strongly through the previous 1,000 stg resistance on Monday and closed at 1,018, two stg off the top of the daily range, which analysts called a bullish sign.
"It should continue early in the session until we meet the first resistance from 1,023 onwards," said Trevor Neil, senior techical analyst at Union Cal Futures.
"The resistance intensifies at 1,045. A close above 1,063 (the high on July 11) would be constructive but unlikely."
He pegged the initial support at the previous 1,000 resistance, followed by last week's low of 965.
Traders said Monday's run-up was purely currency-driven and there were no fresh supply/demand fundamental inputs.
New York cocoa futures ended up sharply and near the day's highs on Monday, propelled by a late-session rush of speculative buying.
The rise was mainly technically driven, with the benchmark September contract clearing a key chart gap between $1,521 and $1,526 per tonne and triggering buy-stops.
